content.text:
Paper audit complete; no files changed.

Main source and narrative

- Main Typst entrypoint: [docs/study.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study.typ:9). It imports the preamble, includes frontmatter plus seven section files at lines 11–18, and renders [docs/refs.bib](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/refs.bib:1) at line 22.
- Title/date/abstract: [docs/study/frontmatter.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/frontmatter.typ:3). It is dated April 3, 2026 at line 8.
- Thesis: Keating is a teaching “metaharness,” not merely a chatbot—an inspectable control layer over plans, artifacts, evaluation, policy search, and revisit cadence. See [introduction.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/introduction.typ:5) and [metaharness.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/metaharness.typ:7).
- Claimed contributions are the metaharness formalization, mathematical synthetic harness, and reproducible separation of archival and synthetic evidence: [introduction.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/introduction.typ:9).
- Evidence claims:
  - 22 raw traces curated to 16 topic/learner pairs: [results.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/results.typ:14).
  - Archival overall 0.61, topic and learner heterogeneity: [results.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/results.typ:32).
  - Student-role contamination in 5/16 sessions: [results.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/results.typ:50).
  - `keating-candidate-22`, allegedly derivative-only, improves the 14-topic suite by 6.703 across 200/200 seeds; evolution wins 29/30 reruns: [results.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/results.typ:56).
  - Retrieval practice is claimed as the largest ablation driver: [results.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/results.typ:74).
- Claim boundary is appropriately cautious: systems/methods evidence, not proven human-learning efficacy. See [discussion.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/discussion.typ:11) and [limitations.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/limitations.typ:3).

High-priority stale or inconsistent material

1. Synthetic results no longer describe the current runtime.

   - The local analysis snapshot was generated April 3 and uses `keating-candidate-22`: [study-analysis.json](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/generated/study-analysis.json:2), policy at line 631.
   - Current policy is `me-candidate-33`: [.keating/state/current-policy.json](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/.keating/state/current-policy.json:2).
   - Its latest local evolution report is a full `core-suite`, not derivative-only: [.keating/outputs/evolution/latest.md](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/.keating/outputs/evolution/latest.md:53).
   - Current code hardcodes 3 synthetic learners per topic, while the paper says 18: [src/core/benchmark.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/core/benchmark.ts:292) versus [methods.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/methods.typ:266).
   - A read-only recomputation against the current local policy/code produced diagnostic—not camera-ready—results of +3.982 overall (3.039–4.985; 200/200 wins), derivative +4.106 (0.413–7.799; 197/200), and non-derivative +3.973 (2.974–4.971). Current ablations rank challenge rate first (+2.227), then retrieval (+1.820), unlike the manuscript.

2. The described optimizer is stale.

   - Methods says the 30 reruns use `src/core/evolution.ts`: [methods.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/methods.typ:268).
   - The analysis script now calls MAP-Elites: [scripts/study-analysis.mjs](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/scripts/study-analysis.mjs:434).
   - MAP-Elites uses grid placement plus a PROSPER winner: [src/core/map-elites.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/core/map-elites.ts:151), especially lines 174–221.
   - This does not match the manuscript’s improve/safety/novelty-gate pseudocode at [methods.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/methods.typ:221).
   - Worse, the script creates a temporary archive path but never passes it at lines 435–439; MAP-Elites defaults to a persistent ignored grid at [map-elites.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/core/map-elites.ts:100). Future “30 reruns” would not be clean independent reruns without fixing that first.

3. Mathematical/pseudocode claims diverge from implementation.

   - Paper defines transfer from retention, `T_r = R(...)`: [methods.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/methods.typ:63). Current implementation derives transfer from `masteryGain`: [benchmark-real.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/core/benchmark-real.ts:182).
   - Paper presents learner count, seed stride, reporting scale, and coefficient bundles as explicit configuration parameters: [methods.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/methods.typ:193). Runtime hardcodes learner count 3 and stride 97 at [benchmark.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/core/benchmark.ts:292), and hardcodes reporting scale `* 100` at line 253.
   - The manuscript says numeric calibration lives in `src/core/benchmark.ts`: [methods.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/methods.typ:79). The deterministic coefficients now live in [src/core/benchmark-real.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/core/benchmark-real.ts:140).

4. Reproducibility/availability claims are currently false for a fresh clone.

   - The manuscript calls `test/final_dataset.json` a checked-in snapshot and says traces are stored in the repository: [results.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/results.typ:14), [availability.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/availability.typ:5).
   - But traces, the curated dataset, derived analysis, and `.keating/` policy state are ignored: [.gitignore](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/.gitignore:35), lines 37–39 and 55. None is tracked.
   - The notebook directly requires the ignored generated JSON: [analysis/study_analysis.py](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/analysis/study_analysis.py:16).
   - A camera-ready update needs a frozen, tracked or hash-addressed dataset, policy, analysis output, configuration, and commit/version identifier.

5. Date/version and served PDF are stale.

   - Manuscript and web page still say April 3, 2026: [frontmatter.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/frontmatter.typ:8), [Paper.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/pages/Paper.tsx:46).
   - Current package version is 3.3.0: [package.json](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/package.json:3), but the paper names no software version or commit.
   - The tracked PDF was created April 3 with Typst 0.14.0. Typst source received substantive engagement-timeline/reward-hacking revisions on April 16, so [web/public/keating-metaharness.pdf](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/public/keating-metaharness.pdf) predates and omits current source content.

TODOs/placeholders

- No literal `TODO`, `TBD`, `FIXME`, or placeholder markers appear in the manuscript.
- Explicit unfinished research:
  - no scorer provenance/inter-rater reliability or human trial: [limitations.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/limitations.typ:3);
  - no reward-hacking audit: [limitations.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/limitations.typ:7);
  - engagement timeline remains unevaluated: [limitations.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/limitations.typ:11);
  - required human RCT and hidden/adversarial benchmark hardening: [discussion.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/discussion.typ:13).
- The separate KeatingBench document is explicitly a draft second-paper plan, not manuscript material: [keatingbench-paper-plan.md](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/plans/keatingbench-paper-plan.md:1). Its experiments remain unrun at lines 93–104 and six drafting decisions remain open at lines 150–162.

Build/reproduction commands

- Exact analysis command documented by the manuscript: `bun scripts/study-analysis.mjs` at [methods.typ](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/study/sections/methods.typ:274).
- [runpod-benchmarks.md](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/runpod-benchmarks.md:63) inconsistently says `node scripts/study-analysis.mjs`.
- No Typst compilation command or `keating:paper` task exists anywhere in the repository. The inferred output command is `typst compile docs/study.typ web/public/keating-metaharness.pdf`, but it is not documented.
- [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md:7) says Typst is managed by devenv, yet [devenv.nix](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/devenv.nix:7) currently includes only Bun. Direct compilation could not be verified because `typst` is unavailable in the current shell.
